articles.title: Crude oil prices sell off more than 7% on Iran peace talk hopes ahead of U.S. midterms
articles.summary: Crude oil prices fell sharply Monday as the presidents of the U.S. and Iran signalled they are open to a diplomatic solution to the conflict that has disrupted energy markets for eight months. But the oil market had priced in the risk of a major military escalation after the elections, gaining more than 10% in October.

articles.title: Options traders are getting anxious on Palantir and Apple ahead of earnings
articles.summary: It's not just the neoclouds and hyperscalers that investors are anxious about. The two stocks have been on trajectories that are distinct from the broader AI trade – with Apple, in particular, trading almost inversely to the Nasdaq 100 Index – but that's not stopping speculators from betting on a reversal in their shares after earnings. articles.title: Oracle files to sell $20 billion in new stock, bonds to finance AI buildout
articles.summary: Oracle filed plans on Monday to issue new stock and more debt to finance its artificial intelligence buildout. Stock and bonds in Oracle, co-founded by former CEO Larry Ellison, have been under pressure amid growing investor concerns about the massive amount of debt being taken on to fund AI infrastructure. The yield on its investment-grade 4.95% bond due in 2031 is currently 7.267%.
